Agnostic Narrator V2 release candidate 0.3.0-rc.6
For SillyTavern 1.19.0 or newer, Chat Completion.

What is in this package
  narrator-director/                 the extension
  Narrator.png                       the Narrator companion card (picture with the card inside)
  Narrator.card.json                 the same card as JSON, if you prefer importing that
  Narrator Companion (PG).preset.json       the Chat Completion preset for general audiences
  Narrator Companion (Mature).preset.json   the preset allowing NSFW and NSFL material where it fits the story
  Narrator Director.quickreplies.json  optional quick-reply buttons for the director's commands

Install
  1. Close SillyTavern.
  2. Copy the folder narrator-director into
       SillyTavern\public\scripts\extensions\third-party\
     (replace the old folder if you have one).
  3. Start SillyTavern.
  4. Characters: import Narrator.png. If you already have a Narrator card with chats, you can instead
     replace its Narrator.png in SillyTavern\data\default-user\characters\ so the chats stay attached.
     When SillyTavern asks whether to allow the card's regex scripts, allow them.
  5. In AI Response Configuration, import both companion presets and select PG or Mature.
     The preset sets the content tone. The Director and Narrator card supply story context.
     If you re-import over an older copy, select the preset again so its new values apply
     (replies are now capped at 1,500 tokens: about 500 is the target, up to 1,000 for action).
  6. Optional: Quick Replies, import Narrator Director.quickreplies.json.
  7. Extensions panel, Narrator Director: choose a connection profile for the director's own calls
     (a cheaper model is fine). With BaiBai Book installed, set "Who keeps the story's memory" to
     "Another extension".

Use
  Open a chat with the Narrator card (alone, or in a group with your character cards).
  The director works in the background; open its inspector from the Extensions panel or with /director.

Details: docs/playing.md and docs/reference.md in the project.
